## Data Import
- Full data set from the end of `05_filtering.R`  
- This contains all 73 sites from FLUXNET2015 with ages from besnard2018 and LAI from MODIS attached  
- Not scaled yet (will happen in `06_engineer.R`, just before ML training etc. begins)

```{r}
df <- read_csv("data/fluxnet/05_filtering/full_filtered.csv")
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
